description: Unit test class for the abstract base service in the Eclipse Hono project, testing server port configurations, TLS options, and related functionalities.

classes.name: AbstractServiceBaseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing AbstractServiceBase functionalities in Eclipse Hono server.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Initializes mock objects for Vertx and EventBus before each test.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates an anonymous subclass of AbstractServiceBase with overridden methods for testing purposes.

methods.name: checkSecurePortAutoSelect
methods.description: Tests default secure port selection when only key store path is set.

methods.name: checkSecurePortExplicitlySet
methods.description: Tests explicitly configured secure port usage.

methods.name: checkNoPortsSet
methods.description: Tests failure when no port configuration is provided.

methods.name: checkInsecureOnlyPort
methods.description: Tests binding to default insecure port when only insecure port is enabled.

methods.name: checkInsecureOnlyPortExplicitlySet
methods.description: Tests binding to explicitly set insecure port.

methods.name: checkBothPortsOpen
methods.description: Tests binding to both secure and insecure default ports when enabled.

methods.name: checkBothPortsSetToSame
methods.description: Tests failure when secure and insecure ports are set to the same value.

methods.name: testAddTlsKeyCertOptionsDisablesAllProtocolVersionsButTls12
methods.description: Verifies only TLSv1.2 is enabled by default in TLS options.

methods.name: testAddTlsKeyCertOptionsDisablesTlsProtocolVersions
methods.description: Verifies only configured TLS protocols are enabled.
